# Tell users when keyboard recovery has reopened their draft

## What & Why
Keyboard users can reopen both draft types, but the flow should also provide a clear announcement that recovery succeeded so users who rely on assistive technology know the saved work is back in the form.

## Done looks like
- Answer recovery announces that the saved draft was reopened.
- Opportunity recovery announces the same outcome.
- The announcement is covered for Enter and Space activation without changing the existing expiry message.
